title: Cinta Kaz
description: Cinta Kaz was Vel Sartha's romantic partner. During the Aldhani heist, Kaz shot Colonel Petigar. When things went bad, Kaz escaped on her own. Kaz and Sartha were charged by Kleya Marki to kill Cassian Andor to prevent leaks. The pair were on Ferrix when the funeral riot occured. In the confussion, Kaz assassinated Imperial attendant Corv.
